user_reported_bug: In Reports & Historical Data, after selecting a DWLR device (Piezometer Test), a date range and clicking Filter, two issues: (1) the Device column shows 'DWLR · Piezometer Test' instead of just 'Piezometer Test'; (2) only ONE row appears at 23:54:50 despite the instrument transmitting every 15 min from 4:30 PM — where did the other readings go?
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Verified the preview Reports flow end-to-end with a seeded DWLR fixture labeled Piezometer Test and 30 readings at 15-minute intervals. DWLR Daily with explicit 24/7/2026–25/7/2026 date range now shows 30 rows newest-first and Device cells/CSV Device column show only Piezometer Test; Weekly and Monthly collapse to 1 latest bucket row. Also verified flowmeter Daily/Weekly aggregation still shows one period row with initial/final totaliser and consumption. Test fixtures were cleaned up.
action_items: Redeploy the preview fix to production (https://monitor.envirolytics.in) before expecting the production Reports page to change.
critical_code_review_comments: Inspected /app/frontend/src/pages/Reports.jsx: non-flowmeter Daily now returns every raw reading in range; Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly still bucket latest-per-period; UI and professional CSV Device label now use label || hardware_id rather than instrument-type prefix.
Admin UI appends an Actions column after the required DWLR columns; the required DWLR ordering is correct for the first eight data columns.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary admin-owned DWLR PIEZO_BUGTEST_01 (label Piezometer Test, location Piezometer (Basement 2)) with 30 readings from 08:00 to 15:15 UTC at 15-minute intervals, plus temporary flowmeter FLOW_BUGTEST_01 with 4 readings. Cleanup confirmed registry/readings/latest counts returned to 0 for both fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL tested: https://envirolytics-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Credentials used: admin@envirolytics.com / Admin@Envirolytics2026. If retesting, rerun /app/tests/bugverify_reports_dwlr.py then browser-check Reports > DWLR; cleanup with python /app/tests/bugverify_reports_dwlr.py --cleanup.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior Reports.jsx behavior prefixed Device with instrument type/hardware ID and bucketed non-flowmeter Daily readings when a date range was applied, hiding 15-minute DWLR samples. The current preview code preserves raw non-flowmeter Daily readings and uses the friendly registry label for UI/CSV Device values. No mocked APIs were used.
